verses.english: The Interior as Not-Self in the Three Times

verses.pali: “Cakkhu, bhikkhave, anattā atītaṁ anāgataṁ paccuppannaṁ …pe… jivhā anattā …pe… mano anattā atīto anāgato paccuppanno.
verses.english: “Mendicants, in the past … future … present the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are not-self …”
